plan.title: Child Improvement Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Tracking progress from baseline to endline by location and coach

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Average score by site
panels.sql: SELECT "Location", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_score FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT "month", SUM("amount") AS total FROM ... GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides an overview of child improvement from baseline to endline. {{p1}} children were assessed at baseline, with improvements tracked by location and coach. The average shuttle run time decreased across most locations, indicating overall progress. Coaches such as AAKASH ZENDE and Rosy showed significant improvements in their respective areas. The monthly trend highlights the consistency of progress over time. The top-performing children are listed in the table for further analysis.
